uig_weaver.text: Everything here was done by hand. The cloth, the thatch, the dry stone. Do not look at me like that, I use a machine for some of it.
Mòran taing for asking. Most visitors take a photograph of the loom and ask if it is for sale.

uig_guide.text: The wall of the broch is hollow, with stairs inside. The stairs and galleries are built into the wall itself, and an Iron Age family and their animals shared the middle.
Centuries later they were still using it. I always say that is the highest praise a building can get.

uig_chess.text: The Lewis Chessmen are the most famous chess pieces in the world. Some of the queens have their hand on their cheek, as if the game has gone on too long.
The pieces were found in a sand dune. A man dug them up in 1831 and they have been travelling ever since, to Edinburgh, London and back again.

uig_crofter.text: I could say something clever about the Atlantic. Instead I will tell you the weather has been working on my roof since March.
Slàinte mhath. That is a good-health toast. I say it with tea, since the tea is stronger.

uig_seal.text: A selkie pup, or something very like one, lolls at the edge of the tide. It gives you a very long look, then a short one, then a yawn.

champ_uig_beachcomber.text: Hello again. Have you seen a small walrus-ivory bishop? No? It was worth asking.

intro: A battle, then. I'll set down the bag. The tide'll keep.
The weather's been generous. So have I, in the team.
champ_uig_beachcomber.win: Well played. A good move, and nothing missing from the board.
champ_uig_beachcomber.tired: Once a week, and the beach will be there on Monday. So will I.
